summary: AI engineer with four years building and shipping production LLM and agentic systems end to end. I design multi-step, tool-using agents with retrieval, prompt engineering and output guardrails, plus evaluation and monitoring — delivered in a regulated healthcare setting. Strong Python, LangChain/LangGraph, RAG and APIs; I own the full loop from prototype to production and focus on reliability, latency and cost.

bullets: Built an LLM-powered clinical decision-support agent that retrieves patient history to generate medication recommendations and AI-assisted diagnostic guidance.
Designed the retrieval, prompt, and output-guardrail layers for a production medical chatbot, improving the reliability of generated recommendations in a regulated domain.
Owned the full AI feature lifecycle: architecture, retrieval and prompt design, output validation, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Built the retrieval and data layer (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis); caching and optimized queries improved data-access performance by **30%** for high-frequency inference calls.
Built an AI-driven wellness platform with LangChain and RAG pipelines, normalizing third-party health data and retrieving context to generate personalized plans.
Developed an AI Virtual Trainer agent with agentic reasoning and personalization, increasing user engagement by **40%**; owned design, development, and deployment.
Engineered a GPT-Canvas-style streaming LLM renderer using token streaming and incremental rendering, achieving **98%** rendering accuracy.
Built SmartMedHx, an AI-assisted patient-intake system applying LLM extraction to automate clinical workflows.
Built Refill Arena from zero to **$1M+ revenue**, owning backend infrastructure, data models, and scalable APIs across **3,200+ brands** and **190+ countries**.
Improved backend performance by **25%** through query optimization and caching; delivered features from requirements to deployment with remote stakeholders.
